limitations: All media were processed from lossy public MP3 previews; PCM packaging cannot restore discarded source detail.
Rain and wind are natural ambient recordings, not isolated clean-room sound components. Wind source is tagged birds.
Thunder #4 is described by its author as without rain; no independent isolation guarantee.
Short loops repeat; cyclic overlap and conservative levels are numerically checked, not a guarantee of inaudible repetition.
Code remains AGPL-3.0-only. CC0 applies to listed media, not the complete SOU1 application.
